text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pengurusan Sisa Pepejal dan

Pembersihan Awam (Deposit Tutup Selamat bagi Kemudahan yang Ditetapkan)

(Pengecualian) 2025.

Pengecualian

2. Menteri mengecualikan pemegang lesen yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual,

yang mempunyai nombor lesen sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) Jadual,

bagi kemudahan pengurusan sisa pepejal yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (3)

Jadual daripada pemakaian peruntukan Bahagian IV, Peraturan-Peraturan

Pengurusan Sisa Pepejal dan Pembersihan Awam (Kemudahan Pengurusan

Sisa Pepejal yang Ditetapkan dan Kelulusan bagi Pembinaan, Pengubahan dan

Penutupan Kemudahan) 2011 [P.U. (A) 302/2011] berkenaan dengan deposit bagi

penutupan selamat yang dikutip dalam tempoh April 2015 hingga Ogos 2018.

SOLID WASTE AND PUBLIC CLEANSING MANAGEMENT ACT 2007

SOLID WASTE AND PUBLIC CLEANSING MANAGEMENT

(DEPOSIT FOR SAFE CLOSURE OF PRESCRIBED SOLID WASTE

MANAGEMENT FACILITIES) (EXEMPTION) ORDER 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 104(1) of the

Solid Waste and Public Cleansing Management Act 2007 [Act 672], the Minister

makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Solid Waste and Public Cleansing Management

(Deposit for Safe Closure of Prescribed Solid Waste Management Facilities)

(Exemption) Order 2025.

Exemption

2. The Minister exempts the licensee specified in the column (1)

of the Schedule, which has licence number as specified in the column (2) of the Schedule,

for the prescribed solid waste management facility specified in the column (3) of the

Schedule from the application of the provision of Part IV, Solid Waste and

Public Cleansing Management (Prescribed Solid Waste Management Facilities and

Approval for the Construction, Alteration and Closure of Facilities) Regulations 2011

[P.U. (A) 302/2011] in respect of deposit for safe closure collected within the period of

April 2015 to August 2018.
